1.title: Homeland Security Intensifies Pursuit of Noncitizens on Voter Rolls
1.summary: Immigrants who said they inadvertently registered to vote while obtaining or renewing driver’s licenses are increasingly facing deportation under the Trump administration.

2.title: Trump Stokes Islamophobia by Calling Democratic Candidates ‘Jihadists’
2.summary: Along with his comments about Muslim candidates, Mr. Trump spoke disparagingly of Somalis in the United States, saying “they’re not smart.”

3.title: Trump Wants to Move On From the Middle East. It’s Not Letting Him.
3.summary: President Trump is eager to declare success in Iran and Gaza, but he is struggling to impose his will in either conflict.

4.title: Powerful 7.4 Earthquake Strikes Colombia, Killing More Than 100
4.summary: The quake shook major cities, including Bogotá, Cali and Medellín. At least 111 people have died, the president said, and the death toll appeared likely to rise as rescuers searched damaged buildings.

5.title: Trump signs order to limit childhood vaccines and split MMR shots
5.summary: The American Academy of Pediatrics calls the recommendation on measles, mumps and rubella shots "dangerous".

6.title: Netanyahu Walks Tightrope on Trump’s Gaza Disarmament Deal
6.summary: The Israeli prime minister, facing a tough upcoming election, is trying to satisfy the sometimes competing demands of his right-wing base and of President Trump.
